WITH trader_type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader AS t
    ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    transaction_count,
    transaction_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(transaction_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM trader_type_counts
),
with_average AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    transaction_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  transaction_count,
  share,
  share - average_share AS share_minus_average
FROM with_average
WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL
  AND share > average_share;
